services.name: Private Events
services.desc: - Guest access to designated facilities and gardens - Climate-controlled restrooms - On-site parking for up to 125 vehicles - Museum staffing for venue assistance, parking direction, and greeting guests entering the museum - A Norfolk Sheriff’s Deputy for grounds security - The Hermitage consists of an historic home, extensive gardens and grounds, and an important art and materials collection. Respect for the home, grounds, and collection are key to ensuring a successful event. - Events are permitted outdoors only. Exceptions can be made for small meetings, lectures, and openings on a case-by-case basis. - Contact information must be provided for all vendors. Must choose from approved

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Plan your Hermitage visit today! We offer several options for groups of various sizes and ages. When planning a group tour or field trip, please schedule at least two weeks in advance to ensure a docent is available. Discover all the Hermitage Museum & Gardens has to offer by scheduling your visit today! Learn more by contacting Reicse Owen at rowen@thehermitagemuseum.org Admission is free at the Hermitage Museum and Gardens. Visitors are invited to take a self-guided tour of the estate, Tuesdays through Sundays from 10 - 5pm with no prior reservation required. Interested in learning all that the Hermitage has to offer? Choose a docent-led tour below and complete a Group Tour Request Form.

services.desc: Throughout this week, students will explore the natural world through the expansive gardens and grounds of the Hermitage Museum.
